findings.title: react and react-dom are 1 major version behind (v18 → v19)
findings.detail: package.json pins react@^18.3.1 and react-dom@^18.3.1 (installed 18.3.1); latest stable is 19.2.7. @types/react@^18.3.12 and @types/react-dom@^18.3.1 must also be bumped to v19 types.
findings.suggested_fix: Update react, react-dom, @types/react, @types/react-dom to ^19 in package.json and run npm install

findings.title: PR creation blocked: GH_TOKEN lacks pull_requests:write scope
findings.detail: Fix was applied on branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-11-react-19 (build and 351 tests passed). Branch was pushed successfully but gh api /repos/.../pulls returned HTTP 403 — the fine-grained PAT in GH_TOKEN does not have the pull_requests:write permission. A human can open the PR manually from the pushed branch.
findings.suggested_fix: Grant pull_requests:write to the claude-maintenance fine-grained PAT, or manually open a PR from branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-11-react-19
